s0201.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on jiawu day, the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat reported that Kaizhou had been newly taken and then lost again and requested reinforcements; an edict ordered three thousand militia conscripted at Pingyang, Yan'an, and elsewhere, and seven thousand troops transferred from Shandong, Henan, Huaimeng, and Tongchuan to reinforce them.
s0201.idiomatic: In spring of the fourth year, on jiawu day of the first month, the Shaanxi branch secretariat reported that Kaizhou had been retaken and lost again and asked for reinforcements; the court ordered three thousand militia levied at Pingyang, Yan'an, and elsewhere and seven thousand troops from Shandong, Henan, Huaimeng, and Tongchuan to reinforce them.

s0202.literal: On dingyou day the prohibition against private salt in Pingyang and elsewhere was strictly enforced.
s0202.idiomatic: On dingyou day the ban on private salt in Pingyang and elsewhere was reaffirmed.

s0203.literal: On renyin day fourteen relay stations were established at Chasutu River.
s0203.idiomatic: On renyin day fourteen relay stations were set up along the Chasutu River.

s0204.literal: On guimao day an edict ordered the repair of the Sage-of-State Temple at Qufu.
s0204.idiomatic: On guimao day an edict ordered repairs to the Sage-of-State Temple at Qufu.

s0205.literal: On yisi day Baekje sent its minister Liang Hao to court; he was granted brocades according to rank.
s0205.idiomatic: On yisi day Baekje sent the minister Liang Hao to court and rewarded him with brocades according to rank.

s0206.literal: Buddhist clerical officials were forbidden to intrude in civilian lawsuits.
s0206.idiomatic: Buddhist clerical officials were forbidden to take up civilian lawsuits.

s0207.literal: On xinhai day Duke of Ansul Zhang Rou was enfeoffed as Duke of Cai; Zhao Bi was made Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
s0207.idiomatic: On xinhai day Zhang Rou, Duke of Ansul, was invested as Duke of Cai, and Zhao Bi was appointed Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

s0208.literal: A Directorate-General for Mining and Smelting was established in all routes.
s0208.idiomatic: Directorate-generals for mining and smelting were established in every route.

s0209.literal: On guichou day an edict enfeoffed Mount Ximu as Mount Wuding, its spirit as Lord Wuding;
s0209.idiomatic: On guichou day an edict named Mount Ximu Mount Wuding and enfeoffed its spirit as Lord Wuding;

s0210.literal: and the spring as Lingyuan, its spirit as Marquis Lingyuan.
s0210.idiomatic: and the spring as Lingyuan, with its spirit enfeoffed as Marquis Lingyuan.

s0211.literal: Mongol troops were conscripted: households with two or three adult males furnished one soldier, those with four or five furnished two, those with six or seven furnished three.
s0211.idiomatic: Mongol troops were levied on a sliding scale: households of two or three adult males supplied one soldier, those of four or five supplied two, and those of six or seven supplied three.

s0212.literal: On yimao day the King of Goryeo, Wang Chŏn, sent envoys to court; an edict comforted them.
s0212.idiomatic: On yimao day King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent envoys to court, and an edict comforted them.

s0213.literal: On wuwu day an Office for Palace City Oversight was established.
s0213.idiomatic: On wuwu day an office for palace-city oversight was established.

s0214.literal: Shangdu's Longxing Prefecture was split off as a separate circuit, conducting branch commissioner affairs;
s0214.idiomatic: Longxing Prefecture in Shangdu was detached as its own circuit, with a branch commissioner conducting its affairs;

s0215.literal: Transport Commissions were established at Kaiyuan and other routes.
s0215.idiomatic: Transport commissions were established at Kaiyuan and other routes.

s0216.idiomatic: The walls of Dadu were built.

s0217.literal: In the second month, on gengshen day, Nianhe Nanhe was restored as Grand Councillor, and Ali was restored as Right Associate of the Central Secretariat.
s0217.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengshen day, Nianhe Nanhe was restored as grand councillor and Ali as Right Associate of the Central Secretariat.

s0218.literal: On dingmao day the Classics Archive was renamed the Academy of Literary Glory, with Ma Tianzhao as director.
s0218.idiomatic: On dingmao day the Classics Archive was renamed the Academy of Literary Glory, with Ma Tianzhao placed in charge.

s0219.literal: On dinghai day Xixia civilian fields were registered and their rents levied.
s0219.idiomatic: On dinghai day civilian fields in Xixia were surveyed and their rents collected.

s0220.literal: The imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.

s0221.literal: An edict ordered the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat to summon and persuade the Song people.
s0221.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Shaanxi branch secretariat to summon and win over the Song people.

s0222.literal: Another edict declared that officials, troops, and civilians at Jiading, Luzhou, Chongqing, Kuizhou, Fu, Da, Zhong, Wan, and Diaoyu, Liyi, Daliang, and elsewhere who could lead the masses to surrender would be generously rewarded and promoted.
s0222.idiomatic: Another edict promised generous rewards and promotion to officials, soldiers, and civilians at Jiading, Luzhou, Chongqing, Kuizhou, Fu, Da, Zhong, Wan, Diaoyu, Liyi, Daliang, and elsewhere who could bring their followers over in surrender.

s0223.literal: In the third month, on jichou day, Yelü Zhu was again made Left Chancellor of the Central Secretariat.
s0223.idiomatic: In the third month, on jichou day, Yelü Zhu was again appointed Left Chancellor of the Central Secretariat.

s0224.literal: On xinmao day eight river-crossing inspectors were established from Tong Pass to Qi County to detect deceit.
s0224.idiomatic: On xinmao day eight river-crossing inspectors were posted from Tong Pass to Qi County to detect fraud.

s0225.literal: On yiwei day an edict ordered a Music Practice Hall built on the Central Capital route and musicians assigned to train there.
s0225.idiomatic: On yiwei day an edict ordered a Music Practice Hall built on the Central Capital route and musicians assigned to train there.

s0226.literal: On jihai day Princes Yan, Mangqala, Namaghan, and Hügechi were granted thirty thousand taels of silver.
s0226.idiomatic: On jihai day Princes Yan, Mangqala, Namaghan, and Hügechi received thirty thousand taels of silver.

s0227.literal: On xinchou day Xiajin County suffered heavy hail.
s0227.idiomatic: On xinchou day Xiajin County was struck by heavy hail.

s0228.literal: On renyin day Antong said: "Recently the secretariat establishment provided for one Grand Councillor and one Left Associate each; now there are five chancellors, which has never been the precedent.
s0228.idiomatic: On renyin day Antong said: "The secretariat establishment recently allowed for one grand councillor and one left associate each, but now there are five chancellors — a number without precedent.

s0229.literal: We propose setting two chancellors; three of us are Mongols and await Your Majesty's appointment.
s0229.idiomatic: We propose appointing two chancellors; three of us are Mongols and await Your Majesty's command.

s0230.literal: " An edict made Antong chief, Shi Tiane second; the rest were to be Mongols and Han used together, without letting the number grow too large;
s0230.idiomatic: " An edict made Antong chief and Shi Tiane second; the remaining posts were to be filled by Mongols and Han in combination, without letting the number grow too large;

s0231.literal: and another edict recommended one or two senior men such as Yao Shu to join in deliberating secretariat affairs.
s0231.idiomatic: and another edict recommended that one or two senior men such as Yao Shu join in deliberating secretariat affairs.

s0232.literal: On dingsi day Yelü Zhu completed palace and county music; an edict granted it the title "Great Accomplishment."
s0232.idiomatic: On dingsi day Yelü Zhu completed the palace and county music, and an edict named it "Great Accomplishment."

s0233.literal: In summer, fourth month, on shenzi day, the palace city was newly built.
s0233.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on shenzi day, the palace city was newly built.

s0234.literal: On xinwei day envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the mountains and rivers.
s0234.idiomatic: On xinwei day envoys were sent to offer sacrifice at the mountains and rivers.

s0235.literal: In the fifth month, on dinghai day, the first of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
s0235.idiomatic: On dinghai day, the first of the fifth month, there was a solar eclipse.

s0236.literal: An edict ordered the Confucius Temple at Shangdu rebuilt.
s0236.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Confucius Temple at Shangdu rebuilt.

s0237.literal: On yiwei day Ying Prefecture suffered great flooding.
s0237.idiomatic: On yiwei day Ying Prefecture was flooded.

s0238.literal: On bingshen day eleven tribes including the Great Fan Nongma behind Weizhou submitted; they were granted imperial patents and gold and silver tally seals.
s0238.idiomatic: On bingshen day eleven tribes including the Great Fan Nongma behind Weizhou submitted and received imperial patents and gold and silver tally seals.

s0239.literal: On jiyou day a darughachi of the hunting households was executed for forging silver tally seals.
s0239.idiomatic: On jiyou day a darughachi of the hunting households was put to death for forging silver tally seals.

s0240.literal: On renzi day an edict on official salaries in all routes ordered silver-tax households to pay one extra tael per four taels to supply them.
s0240.idiomatic: On renzi day an edict on official salaries in every route ordered silver-tax households to pay one additional tael for every four taels to fund them.

s0241.literal: On bingchen day five cities of Bozhou in Dongping were split off as a separate circuit.
s0241.idiomatic: On bingchen day five cities of Bozhou in Dongping were detached as a separate circuit.

s0242.literal: In the sixth month, on renxu day, because silkworm disasters afflicted the Central Capital, Shuntian, Dongping, and elsewhere, households' silk levies were remitted in varying degrees.
s0242.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renxu day, silkworm disasters in the Central Capital, Shuntian, Dongping, and elsewhere brought remission of silk levies in varying degrees.

s0243.literal: On yichou day Shi Tiane was again made Left Chancellor of the Central Secretariat; Qutudar and Yelü Zhu were both demoted to Grand Councillors, Bayan was demoted to Right Associate, Lian Xixian to Left Associate, and Ali and Zhang Wenqian were both demoted to Vice Grand Councillors.
s0243.idiomatic: On yichou day Shi Tiane was again made Left Chancellor; Qutudar and Yelü Zhu were both reduced to grand councillors, Bayan to Right Associate, Lian Xixian to Left Associate, and Ali and Zhang Wenqian to vice grand councillors.

s0244.literal: On yiyou day Prince Yisibuge was granted five thousand taels of silver and three hundred bolts; this became annual.
s0244.idiomatic: On yiyou day Prince Yisibuge received five thousand taels of silver and three hundred bolts, to be granted annually thereafter.

s0246.literal: Qara and Yin Hong reported that Goryeo envoys Song Junfei and Jin Zan had failed to guide the mission through to Japan; an edict rebuked King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo and ordered him to send officials there to proclaim the Emperor's will, with obtaining results as the deadline.
s0246.idiomatic: Qara and Yin Hong reported that the Goryeo envoys Song Junfei and Jin Zan had failed to guide the mission through to Japan; an edict rebuked King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo and ordered him to send officials there to proclaim the Emperor's will, with concrete results as the deadline.

s0247.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on bingxu day, the first of the month, an edict ordered ten water relay stations established from Zhongxing Route to Dongsheng west of Xijing.
s0247.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingxu day, the first of the month, an edict ordered ten water relay stations built from Zhongxing Route to Dongsheng west of Xijing.

s0248.literal: On wuxu day Yue Lin, Pacification Commissioner of Xizhou, was dismissed and his people placed under Nanjing Route;
s0248.idiomatic: On wuxu day Yue Lin, pacification commissioner of Xizhou, was dismissed and his people placed under Nanjing Route;

s0249.literal: Pacification Commissioner Li Zongjie of Huaimeng Route was dismissed and his people placed under that route.
s0249.idiomatic: Li Zongjie, pacification commissioner of Huaimeng Route, was dismissed and his people placed under that route.

s0250.literal: One thousand unregistered households in Gongchang, Fengxiang, Jingzhao, and elsewhere were mobilized to repair Sichuan mountain roads, bridges, and plank paths.
s0250.idiomatic: One thousand unregistered households in Gongchang, Fengxiang, Jingzhao, and elsewhere were mobilized to repair mountain roads, bridges, and plank paths in Sichuan.

s0251.literal: Ailu, darughachi of Daming Route, and Prefect Zhang Hongfan and others misappropriated government money and were dismissed.
s0251.idiomatic: Ailu, darughachi of Daming Route, and the prefect Zhang Hongfan and others misappropriated government funds and were dismissed.

s0252.literal: On renyin day the prohibition against pasturing in the capital region was strictly enforced.
s0252.idiomatic: On renyin day the ban on pasturing in the capital region was reaffirmed.

s0253.literal: On jiayin day an edict stated that among newly submitted poor of Yijina who had borrowed and could not repay, the government would repay for them and also provide oxen, tools, seed, and grain.
s0253.idiomatic: On jiayin day an edict declared that among newly submitted poor in Yijina who had borrowed and could not repay, the government would repay their debts and also provide oxen, tools, seed, and grain.

s0254.literal: One thousand eight hundred troops from the Eastern Capital army were conscripted to serve in the Palace Guard.
s0254.idiomatic: One thousand eight hundred Eastern Capital troops were levied for the Palace Guard.

s0255.literal: In the eighth month, on gengshen day, Saturn encroached on Tianzun.
s0255.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengshen day, Saturn encroached on Tianzun.

s0256.literal: On xinyou day the prohibition against private salt, wine, and vinegar on the Pingluan Route was strictly enforced.
s0256.idiomatic: On xinyou day the ban on private salt, wine, and vinegar on the Pingluan Route was reaffirmed.

s0257.literal: On bingyin day the Palace Provisioner was reestablished, with the former Right Chancellor Xian Zhen as commissioner.
s0257.idiomatic: On bingyin day the Palace Provisioner was restored, with the former Right Chancellor Xian Zhen as commissioner.

s0258.literal: On dingchou day Prince Hügechi was enfeoffed as Prince of Yunnan and granted a gold-plated silver seal with camel-shaped knob.
s0258.idiomatic: On dingchou day Prince Hügechi was invested as Prince of Yunnan and granted a gold-plated silver seal with a camel-shaped knob.

s0259.literal: On renwu day Venus encroached on the great star of Xuanyuan.
s0259.idiomatic: On renwu day Venus encroached on the great star of Xuanyuan.

s0260.literal: Qiemian was ordered to campaign against Jiandu.
s0260.idiomatic: Qiemian was ordered to campaign against Jiandu.

s0261.literal: King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent his Secretariat Director Guo Rubi to congratulate the Emperor's birthday.
s0261.idiomatic: King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent his secretariat director Guo Rubi to congratulate the Emperor on his birthday.

s0262.literal: Aju raided as far as Xiangyang, capturing fifty thousand persons and five thousand horses and cattle.
s0262.idiomatic: Aju raided as far as Xiangyang and captured fifty thousand people and five thousand horses and cattle.

s0263.literal: The Song sent infantry and cavalry to resist; Aju led cavalry and defeated them.
s0263.idiomatic: The Song sent infantry and cavalry to resist, but Aju led cavalry and defeated them.

s0264.literal: In the ninth month, on renchen day, a jade hall was built within the Broad Cold Palace.
s0264.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renchen day, a jade hall was built within the Broad Cold Palace.

s0265.literal: On yiwei day Grand Commander Wang Liangchen requested a fort at Wuzhangde Mountain to control Jiangnan and block the approach to Diaoyu; this was granted.
s0265.idiomatic: On yiwei day Grand Commander Wang Liangchen asked to build a fort at Wuzhangde Mountain to control Jiangnan and block the approach to Diaoyu; the court agreed.

s0266.literal: On wushen day Xu Heng was made Chancellor of the Imperial Academy.
s0266.idiomatic: On wushen day Xu Heng was appointed Chancellor of the Imperial Academy.

s0267.literal: King Tran Quang Binh of Annam sent envoys with tribute; a gracious edict replied.
s0267.idiomatic: King Tran Quang Binh of Annam sent envoys with tribute, and a gracious edict replied.

s0268.literal: The Six Ministries branch was established at Dali and elsewhere; Kuokuodai was made Minister and concurrently Tutor to the Prince of Yunnan, Chai Zhen Minister and concurrently Prefect Commandant, and Ning Yuan Vice Minister and concurrently Chief of Staff.
s0268.idiomatic: A branch Six Ministries was established at Dali and elsewhere; Kuokuodai was made minister and concurrently tutor to the Prince of Yunnan, Chai Zhen minister and concurrently prefect commandant, and Ning Yuan vice minister and concurrently chief of staff.

s0269.literal: On gengxu day Prince Hügechi of Yunnan was dispatched to garrison Dali, Shanchan, Chahanzhang, Chituo'ge'er, Jinchi, and elsewhere; an edict comforted officials and people.
s0269.idiomatic: On gengxu day Prince Hügechi of Yunnan was sent to garrison Dali, Shanchan, Chahanzhang, Chituo'ge'er, Jinchi, and elsewhere, and an edict comforted officials and people.

s0270.literal: Another edict instructed Annam that its ruler should come to court, sons and younger brothers should serve as hostages, registered people should furnish military service and pay taxes, and a darughachi should be placed to govern them.
s0270.idiomatic: Another edict instructed Annam that its ruler should come to court, sons and younger brothers should serve as hostages, registered people should furnish military service and pay taxes, and a darughachi should be placed to govern them.

s0271.literal: On guichou day the prohibition against monks, nuns, and Daoist priests engaging in commercial tax, wine, and vinegar in Xixia, Zhongxing, and other routes was strictly enforced.
s0271.idiomatic: On guichou day the ban on monks, nuns, and Daoist priests trading in commercial tax, wine, and vinegar in Xixia, Zhongxing, and other routes was reaffirmed.

s0272.literal: The imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.

s0273.literal: Wang E requested establishing an examination and selection law; an imperial directive ordered discussion for implementation, but the responsible offices objected and the matter was dropped.
s0273.idiomatic: Wang E asked to establish an examination and selection law; an imperial directive ordered discussion for implementation, but the responsible offices objected and the matter was dropped.

s0274.literal: In winter, tenth month, on xinyou day, the State Revenue Office reported: "At Bieqiechi Mountain, stone wool woven into cloth cannot be burned by fire.
s0274.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on xinyou day, the State Revenue Office reported: "At Bieqiechi Mountain, stone wool woven into cloth cannot be burned by fire.

s0276.literal: On renxu day the imperial son-in-law Buhua was granted a silver seal.
s0276.idiomatic: On renxu day the imperial son-in-law Buhua received a silver seal.

s0277.literal: Li Fu, darughachi of Yutong and Yan Prefectures, summoned western Tibetan tribal chiefs to bring their people in submission; Anubandige and others were made administrators of Hewu and elsewhere, all granted imperial patents and gold and silver tally seals.
s0277.idiomatic: Li Fu, darughachi of Yutong and Yan Prefectures, summoned western Tibetan tribal chiefs to bring their people in submission; Anubandige and others were made administrators of Hewu and elsewhere and granted imperial patents and gold and silver tally seals.

s0278.literal: Zalan, a western Tibetan official of Tieqi Cheng, sent his son Tianlang bearing patents and gold seals previously received from Prince Möngke to request new appointments; this was granted.
s0278.idiomatic: Zalan, a western Tibetan official of Tieqi Cheng, sent his son Tianlang with patents and gold seals previously received from Prince Möngke to request new appointments; the court agreed.

s0279.literal: On jiazi day Jupiter encroached on the great star of Xuanyuan.
s0279.idiomatic: On jiazi day Jupiter encroached on the great star of Xuanyuan.

s0280.literal: On xinwei day Taiyuan presented two stalks of fine grain from different fields sharing one ear.
s0280.idiomatic: On xinwei day Taiyuan presented two stalks of fine grain from different fields sharing one ear.

s0281.literal: On jiaxu day paper notes were issued in relief to newly submitted civilians including Chen Zhong.
s0281.idiomatic: On jiaxu day paper notes were issued in relief to newly submitted civilians including Chen Zhong.

s0282.literal: The State Revenue Commissioner requested measured reduction of routine expenditures; this was granted.
s0282.idiomatic: The state revenue commissioner asked for measured reduction of routine expenditures, and the court agreed.

s0283.literal: On gengchen day regulations were fixed for hereditary preferment of officials' sons and grandsons by rank.
s0283.idiomatic: On gengchen day regulations were fixed for hereditary preferment of officials' sons and grandsons by rank.

s0284.literal: In the eleventh month, on yiyou day, sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0284.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yiyou day, sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0285.literal: On wuxu day Xin'ai County was established; Huocha and Li Gianu were placed in command of their troops to garrison it.
s0285.idiomatic: On wuxu day Xin'ai County was established, with Huocha and Li Gianu placed in command of their troops to garrison it.

s0286.literal: On jiachen day a Grand Commander headquarters was established on the Kuifu Route to garrison Kaizhou.
s0286.idiomatic: On jiachen day a grand commander headquarters was established on the Kuifu Route to garrison Kaizhou.

s0287.literal: On yisi day Saturn encroached on Tianzun's companion star.
s0287.idiomatic: On yisi day Saturn encroached on Tianzun's companion star.

s0288.literal: The prohibition against hunting in the capital region was strictly enforced.
s0288.idiomatic: The ban on hunting in the capital region was reaffirmed.

s0289.literal: Liu Zheng, Branch Pacification Commissioner of Nanjing, came to court and memorialized that the strategy against Song should begin with Xiangyang.
s0289.idiomatic: Liu Zheng, branch pacification commissioner of Nanjing, came to court and argued that the campaign against Song should begin with Xiangyang.

s0290.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiaxu day, nine thousand six hundred fifty taels of silver were granted in reward for battle merit to officers and soldiers under Nahuai, commander-in-chief of Henan Route, with paper notes, bolts, and saddles and bridles according to rank.
s0290.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiaxu day, nine thousand six hundred fifty taels of silver were granted in reward for battle merit to officers and soldiers under Nahuai, commander-in-chief of Henan Route, with paper notes, bolts, and saddles and bridles according to rank.

s0291.literal: On bingzi day Prince Yisangge's starving subjects received relief.
s0291.idiomatic: On bingzi day starving subjects under Prince Yisangge received relief.

s0292.literal: On dingchou day sixty thousand bolts of cloth were issued to newly conscripted troops in Liaodong.
s0292.idiomatic: On dingchou day sixty thousand bolts of cloth were issued to newly conscripted troops in Liaodong.

s0293.literal: On jimao day seven water relay stations were established on the Liaodong Route.
s0293.idiomatic: On jimao day seven water relay stations were established on the Liaodong Route.

s0294.literal: Two thousand twenty-five meritorious officers and soldiers under Marshal Aju were rewarded with fifty-five thousand three hundred taels of silver and fifty taels of gold, plus brocades, saddles, and bridles according to rank.
s0294.idiomatic: Two thousand twenty-five meritorious officers and soldiers under Marshal Aju received fifty-five thousand three hundred taels of silver and fifty taels of gold, plus brocades, saddles, and bridles according to rank.

s0295.literal: On gengchen day three thousand Jurchen and Suiban troops were conscripted.
s0295.idiomatic: On gengchen day three thousand Jurchen and Suiban troops were levied.

s0296.literal: A Directorate-General for Ortogh of the Princes was established.
s0296.idiomatic: A directorate-general for the princes' ortogh was established.

s0297.literal: Yueyang and Hezhou counties in Pingyang Route were annexed into Jishi; Yijin County in Bazhou was restored; Liyang County in Anxi Route was annexed into Lintong.
s0297.idiomatic: Yueyang and Hezhou counties in Pingyang Route were annexed into Jishi; Yijin County in Bazhou was restored; and Liyang County in Anxi Route was annexed into Lintong.

s0298.literal: That year throughout the empire there were 1,644,030 households.
s0298.idiomatic: That year the empire registered 1,644,030 households.

s0299.literal: Locusts afflicted Shandong, northern Henan, and other routes; Shulu County in Shuntian suffered drought; rents were remitted.
s0299.idiomatic: Locusts struck Shandong, northern Henan, and other routes; Shulu County in Shuntian suffered drought; rents were remitted.

s0300.literal: One hundred fourteen persons were sentenced to death.
s0300.idiomatic: One hundred fourteen persons were sentenced to death.
